summary.intent: Resolve a merge conflict on PR #485, then decide and plan the next Callisto work (did-you-mean for E102, private workspace root handling, showing versioned-but-not-published packages, stale trail cleanup), and execute it in parallel with agent teams.
summary.outcome: Resolved and pushed #485, confirmed 0.19.0 released, closed 26 stale trails, and settled the plan. The versioned-not-published implementer's work was reviewed, verified, committed, signed, pushed on feat/versioned-not-published and linked to trail #250; the other two implementers had not yet been reviewed.

repo: Private packages are versioned (bump, changelog, dependents) but never published; they are excluded from the 'Merging will publish' table. In 0.19.0 callisto-fixtures was versioned with its fixed group while only four crates published.
WS-DISC-08 already hides a private root package.json with no version that only holds workspaces; a versioned private root is still listed and publish-to=["none"] doesn't hide it (trail #179).

Release preview schema: PublishOutlook::Planned gained an optional versioned_only field with serde default and skip_serializing_if, so old preview files still load and RELEASE_PREVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION is unchanged.
publish_outlook_in uses has_dispatchable_target to split bumped packages into planned vs versioned-only.
Changesets are written in a layered shape (what changed, why it helps, what to do), routed through the courier agent when the plugin update lands, and checked by a fresh reader.
Verification chain per PR: pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and full `just workflow-contracts`, checked by exit code, plus a real run of the built binary in a scratch worktree.
Several full-suite tests (init unsupported workspace, lifecycle e2e, pnpm/uv native resolution) need network or uv cache and fail in the sandbox.

code.finding: PublishOutlook::Planned carries versioned_only: Vec<String>; publish_outlook_in loops over preview.packages once, and a Blocked outlook passes through untouched.
publish_section renders the 'Versioned, not published' line right after the publish table, before the _note_ lines. The line also appears alone when nothing publishes.
REL-PR-10 now describes the versioned-not-published line, including the nothing-publishes case.

workflow: Run the pairwise overlap check between parallel branches before pushing, and keep one open PR at a time while reviews are pending.
Mutation check (remove the fix, confirm the test fails, restore) gives red-then-green evidence.
Subagent reports are not trustworthy as-is: re-run verification, review the diff and re-run unconfirmed failures outside the sandbox before pushing.
Clean up merged worktrees and branches after confirming the tip is in origin/main.
Searching the web for industry practice yielded thin results; mark what is confirmed versus unconfirmed instead of claiming a default.
Closing trails is reversible via `entire trail update N --status open`.

friction: Overlap check was run after pushing parallel PRs, which produced the conflict on #485.
Stale branches and worktrees accumulated while new PRs were opened.
Web searches did not confirm whether Changesets, Lerna or Nx skip private workspace roots by default.
Subagent's `git switch -c` appeared to create a branch but left it on the old one.
Four tests failed in the sandbox from network denial and uv cache problems, and the subagent lost the exit code of the --no-fail-fast run.
The user repeatedly had to ask for a firm recommendation instead of a survey of options.
open_items: Review and verify the other two implementers (did-you-mean for E102, private workspace root skip) before pushing; do the pairwise overlap check across all three branches.
Run the full test suite outside the sandbox to confirm the four failing tests also fail or pass on main.
Decide whether the versioned-only line goes before or after the _note_ lines.
Check done-when on outcome trails #173, #176, #177, #178, #233, #237, #245, #246 and #198 before closing them.
Close #152 with the 'no soft changeset lint' decision recorded, and update trail #179 with the private-root decision.
Trails #180 (first real release check), #247 (0.18/0.19 timings), #162 and #250 still have follow-ups.
The private-root rule (skip unless named in [[package]], with a status note) still needs the user's explicit go.
ADR 12 (shared tag across a group) deferred pending a design decision.
Possible follow-up: mark private rows as 'not published' in the summary table if the new line reads ambiguously.
Write the plan to .claude/plans/ so it survives a context reset (offered, not confirmed).
The user needs to delete #484's remote branch and handle the unused wisp-plugins worktree.
